title: Interior Architect
description:
**Company:** SNC Promoters \& Developers Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Defence Colony, Delhi  
**Salary:** ₹50,000 – ₹80,000 per month (Based on Experience \& Skills)  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time \| On\-Site  
**Experience Required:** 5–6 Years  
**Joining:** Immediate / Short Notice Preferred

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

SNC Promoters \& Developers Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a highly creative, detail\-oriented, and technically strong **Interior Architect** to join our team in Delhi.

The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in **residential and commercial interior projects**, with strong expertise in **interior planning, working drawings, GFC drawings, space planning, 3D visualization, materials, and site execution**.

The candidate should be capable of independently handling projects from **concept development and design documentation to site execution and coordination**, while maintaining design quality, technical accuracy, project timelines, budgets, and client expectations.

This role requires a combination of **design expertise, architectural detailing, technical drawing skills, site coordination, vendor/contractor management, and client communication**.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Develop **interior architectural concepts, space planning, layouts, and design solutions** for residential and commercial projects.
* Prepare detailed **AutoCAD working drawings, GFC drawings, furniture layouts, electrical layouts, ceiling layouts, flooring layouts, and construction details**.
* Develop **architectural and interior detailing** required for project execution.
* Create **3D models, renders, and client presentations** using relevant visualization software.
* Understand client requirements, functional needs, design preferences, project scope, and budgets.
* Conduct **site visits, measurements, site inspections, and execution follow\-ups**.
* Ensure drawings are accurate and aligned with actual **site conditions and measurements**.
* Coordinate with **clients, contractors, vendors, consultants, suppliers, and site teams** throughout project execution.
* Coordinate with relevant **civil, structural, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and other services** wherever required.
* Ensure the approved design intent is maintained during site execution.
* Select and recommend appropriate **materials, finishes, furniture, fixtures, colours, textures, and architectural/interior elements**.
* Prepare and review **BOQs, estimates, and quantity\-related documentation** as required.
* Coordinate design revisions based on client requirements, site conditions, and execution requirements.
* Review site execution against approved drawings, specifications, and design requirements.
* Identify and resolve **design, drawing, measurement, and execution\-related issues** at site.
* Coordinate with contractors regarding **drawings, dimensions, materials, detailing, and execution requirements**.
* Maintain proper **project drawings, revisions, technical documentation, and design records**.
* Monitor project timelines and ensure timely completion of drawings and design deliverables.
* Manage multiple projects/tasks simultaneously while maintaining quality, accuracy, and deadlines.

REQUIRED SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS

* Bachelor's Degree in **Architecture, Interior Design, or a relevant field**.
* **5–6 years of relevant experience** in Interior Architecture / Interior Design.
* Strong proficiency in **AutoCAD (Mandatory)**.
* Hands\-on experience with **SketchUp (Mandatory)**.
* Working knowledge of at least one visualization/rendering software such as **Lumion, V\-Ray, Enscape, 3ds Max, Revit, or similar**.
* Strong understanding of **space planning, interior detailing, working drawings, GFC drawings, materials, finishes, furniture, and execution processes**.
* Practical knowledge of **site execution and contractor/vendor coordination**.
* Understanding of **civil, electrical, plumbing, HVAC and other services coordination**.
* Strong design presentation and **client communication skills**.
* Ability to independently handle design and technical responsibilities.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders and manage project deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail, technical accuracy, and problem\-solving abilities.

MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS

* **5–6 years of relevant experience in Interior Architecture / Interior Design.**
* **Portfolio is mandatory.**
* Strong knowledge of **AutoCAD and SketchUp**.
* Strong experience in preparing **working drawings and GFC drawings**.
* Experience with **residential and/or commercial interior projects**.
* Proficiency in at least **one rendering/visualization software** such as Lumion, V\-Ray, Enscape, 3ds Max, or Revit.
* Practical experience in **site visits, site coordination, and execution**.
* Experience coordinating with **contractors, vendors, and site teams**.
* Candidates with **less than 5 years of relevant experience will not be considered**.
* Applications **without a portfolio will not be considered**.

PREFERRED ATTRIBUTES

* Experience in **luxury residential or premium commercial projects**.
* Strong knowledge of **architectural/interior detailing and construction drawings**.
* Experience in **façade/elevation or architectural detailing** will be an advantage.
* Knowledge of **Revit/BIM** will be an advantage.
* Experience coordinating with **civil, structural and MEP consultants**.
* Strong rendering and visualization skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects.
* Strong aesthetic sense combined with a **practical, technical, and execution\-oriented approach**.
* Good client\-handling and presentation skills.

WHY JOIN US

* Opportunity to work on **premium residential and commercial projects**.
* Exposure to the **complete project lifecycle from concept to execution**.
* Direct involvement in **live projects, site execution, and client interactions**.
* Opportunity to work closely with **contractors, vendors, consultants, and project teams**.
* Creative and collaborative work environment.
* Career growth and professional development opportunities.
* Opportunity to take ownership of design and execution responsibilities.

TO APPLY

Please share your **updated Resume along with your Portfolio**.

**Applications without a Portfolio will not be considered.**

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

**Work Location:** In Person

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹80,000\.00 per month

title: Application Engineering, Principal Engineer
description:
New Delhi, National Capital Territory of Delhi, India


**Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 18878 **Date posted** 09/21/2026  
**We Are**


At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self\-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high\-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.

**You Are**


You are a DDR/LPDDR Controller System Architecture Specialist who can work directly with customer architects to close real system\-level memory subsystem design decisions.


You are comfortable discussing SoC integration, memory subsystem architecture, controller configuration, performance optimization, power management, validation, and interoperability topics. You can help customers evaluate technical trade\-offs and guide them toward practical architecture decisions.


This is a customer\-facing technical role. You will help customers integrate DDR/LPDDR controller IP into complex SoCs, identify key requirements or gaps, and translate customer feedback into actionable input for Synopsys Product Management, R\&D, and roadmap planning.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Own the technical architecture engagement for DDR/LPDDR controller IP with strategic customers, from early platform requirements through architecture closure and initial deployment readiness.
* Work with customer architects and engineering teams to define suitable DDR/LPDDR memory subsystem configurations for advanced SoC platforms.
* Analyze system\-level trade\-offs related to memory bandwidth, latency, power efficiency, quality of service, reliability, validation, and scalability.
* Translate customer platform requirements and integration constraints into clear feedback for Synopsys Product Management, R\&D, and roadmap planning.
* Support technical closure of design wins by providing architecture guidance, configuration recommendations and competitive positioning.
* Develop reusable technical material, application notes, and customer\-facing guidance based on real engagement experience.
* Train FAEs and customer teams on DDR/LPDDR architecture, memory subsystem integration, performance tuning, validation expectations, and deployment best practices.

**The Impact You Will Have**

* Improve the quality of DDR/LPDDR design wins by ensuring customer memory architectures are technically sound before commitment.
* Strengthen Synopsys DDR/LPDDR roadmap by feeding real customer memory subsystem requirements into product planning and R\&D execution.
* Reduce customer integration risk by identifying architecture, performance, power, validation, and bring\-up issues early.
* Help establish Synopsys as a trusted technical partner for next\-generation AI, HPC, mobile, automotive, networking, and edge computing platforms.
**What You’ll Need**

* Bachelors and/or Masters Degree in Electrical and/or Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science
* 5\+ years of experience in DDR/LPDDR architecture, memory subsystem design, SoC integration, silicon validation, systems engineering, applications engineering, or customer\-facing technical leadership.
* Solid understanding of DDR and/or LPDDR controller IP, including memory architecture concepts, controller configuration, scheduling, quality of service, power management, training, validation, or system integration.
* Good system\-level understanding of SoC integration and ability to reason through memory bandwidth, latency, power efficiency, quality of service, reliability, validation, and software/firmware trade\-offs.
* Experience engaging directly with customer architects, design teams, validation teams, and technical decision\-makers.
* Ability to translate ambiguous customer requirements into clear technical recommendations, product feedback, and closure plans.
* Strong technical communication skills, including clear written analysis, structured trade\-off explanation, and ability to align customer, sales, product, and engineering teams.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Linux, firmware bring\-up, or software\-driven debug of DDR/LPDDR subsystems.
* Familiarity with advanced SoC architectures used in AI, HPC, automotive, mobile, networking, or compute platforms.
* Experience with memory performance analysis, traffic modeling, quality\-of\-service management, memory hierarchy optimization, or system\-level benchmarking.
* Knowledge of advanced topics such as DDR5, LPDDR5X, LPDDR6, memory training algorithms, RAS features, chiplet\-based memory architectures, or AI memory bandwidth optimization.

**The Team You’ll be a Part Of**


You will be part of our IP high\-performance computing applications engineering team, a group of dedicated professionals who are passionate about technology and innovation. The team focuses on helping customers integrate more capabilities into SoCs faster, working collaboratively across geographic and organizational boundaries to drive revenue growth and accelerate business closure.

**Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, military veteran status, or disability.
